Name: A Slightly Cuter Version of Marlon for Seasonal Slightly Cuter Marlon ( Vanilla Friendly ) (Again)
Author: jasmgne
Description:
I've started playing Stardew Valley again and I was looking at a previous version I had made of Marlon and decided he needed a (slight) change from my old one.
So, once again (lol):
I am but a simple person. I see an NPC and think, "Hmm, what if they were a little hotter?"
That's how this mod came to be. I'm not an artist, and certainly don't claim to be one, but I thought I'd share the (new) Marlon portraits I made for my game!
You need [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url]﻿ or alternatively [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5969]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic for SVE[/url], depending on what version of Marlon you are going to download. This mod will do nothing if it is not downloaded!

HOW TO INSTALL:

[b]Pay mind to what file you are downloading because the normal version and SVE version won't work interchangeably![/b]

FOR Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic

[list]
[*]DO NOT USE A MOD MANAGER. Download the mod manually and unzip.[/*]
[*]Open the folder [CP] Seasonal Cute Characters, open assets folder, then the Portrait folder[/*]
[*]Copy and paste the Marlon folder into the Portraits folder[/*]
[*]Replace files when prompted[/*]
[/list]FOR Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic for SVE

[list]
[*]DO NOT USE A MOD MANAGER. Download the mod manually and unzip.[/*]
[*]Open the folder [CP] Seasonal Cute Characters SVE, open the assets folder, then the Portrait folder[/*]
[*]Copy and paste the MarlonFay folder into the Portraits folder[/*]
[*]Replace files when prompted[/*]
[/list]A big thank you to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Poltergeister]Potlergeister[/url] for putting so much time and effort into this amazing mod! :)
